authority: 2026-09-09 live MCP runtime/security reconciliation against merged issues #168 and #173 plus active issue #196
summary: MCP is operationally usable and the OAuth sandbox-write boundary from issue #168 remains remediated, but MCP is not security-cleared because authenticated process execution still has host-user shell blast radius.

blocking_findings.detail: Authenticated start_process executes arbitrary PowerShell 7 as the normal Lauri user with inherited environment; command preflight is policy control, not an adversarial sandbox.

hardening_findings.detail: Streamable HTTP enables Host/DNS-rebinding protection but does not configure allowedOrigins; invalid Origin was not explicitly rejected with 403.

Deployed @modelcontextprotocol/sdk is 1.24.3. The current per-request server/transport construction matches the documented workaround for the affected cross-client response-leak advisory, but the dependency should still be upgraded.

A separate mcp-home-test Caddy listens on all interfaces:8443 with an Any-remote firewall rule and proxies to active backend 3022. Old public-IP reachability failed, but LAN/WireGuard/Tailscale-interface reachability was confirmed. Do not terminate while foreign work remains.
Public /health exposes backend generation, PID, request counts, and live process count.

confirmed_controls: Production backend 3011 binds loopback; WireGuard portproxy ingress is restricted by firewall to peer 10.203.0.1.
Public /mcp requires bearer authentication and public origin is HTTPS.
Host is allowlisted and OAuth redirect URIs are constrained.
Public Caddy strips caller-supplied Tailscale-User-Login and Tailscale-Funnel-Request; a forged owner-header probe through public ingress returned 403.
Access tokens expire after one hour and per-caller process concurrency is capped.
Production task runs as Lauri at normal integrity rather than elevated administrator integrity.
Active clone-a OAuth state is protected from CodexSandboxUsers: the directory and oauth.json currently expose only Lauri, SYSTEM, and Administrators; launcher hardening reapplies this boundary.
Public OAuth refresh tokens rotate with bounded retry grace and replay/family revocation handling (issue #173 / PR #178).
remediation_order: Reduce shell blast radius with a dedicated lower-privilege service identity/workspace/egress policy where practical.
Add explicit Origin allowlisting/rejection for Streamable HTTP.
Upgrade @modelcontextprotocol/sdk to a patched maintained release and rerun conformance/security tests.
Narrow or retire the 8443 home-test lane only after its foreign work is safely migrated or drained.

evidence.oauth_store_acl_observation: Current clone-a directory/oauth.json ACL has Lauri/SYSTEM/Administrators only; zero CodexSandboxUsers ACEs observed on 2026-09-09.
evidence.isolated_oauth_store_proof: chosen access-token record accepted by verifyAccessToken in isolated temporary store
evidence.oauth_sandbox_write_boundary: REMEDIATED via PR #170 / issue #168; current ACL reverified live on 2026-09-09
evidence.refresh_token_rotation: REMEDIATED via issue #173 / PR #178; current source includes bounded retry grace and replay detection
